post.description: This slice accepts APPROVE and DECLINE on held, unstarted items. A same-restaurant Kitchen bearer with the individually provisioned allergy-review permission is required. expectedVersion refers to the item. Replays using the previous version return VERSION_CONFLICT. Reasons are private audit data. Customer sees a separate safe reviewMessage. Decline cancels only the affected item and removes it from the payable bill.

post.description: Open owned session required for first submission. Scope idempotency to session and UUID key. Identical replay returns the original acceptance, even if the request has advanced; history returns current state.

get.description: Current requests for the terminal-owned session.
Current and completed requests scoped to the staff restaurant. Personal Waiter queues include their owned requests and their table coverage. Shared workstation access is read-only.

patch.description: A personally authenticated on-duty Waiter with visit coverage may claim an unassigned Submitted request by acknowledging it, then advance their own request to IN_PROGRESS and COMPLETED. Requires the current request version.

post.description: Explicitly hand off READY food. SERVED requires DINE_IN; COLLECTED requires TAKEAWAY. expectedVersion is the order version. A stale replay returns VERSION_CONFLICT.

get.description: Check review eligibility and read an existing review. Only a session owned by the terminal is visible. READY alone does not grant eligibility.

post.description: Optional review after at least one item actually served or collected. Send at least one rating, topic or nonblank comment. Skip by making no submission. One review per session. Same-key replay returns the original review. A different key after acceptance returns REVIEW_ALREADY_EXISTS.

get.description: Restaurant-scoped food or preparation feedback. Filters to Kitchen topics and omits the session identifier, destination, and Manager notes. Includes relevant negative feedback.
